title: Outlook on the web: inline Copilot chat for drafting emails without opening the sidebar
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, admin paths and audit command are supported, and it distinguishes existing Copilot controls from the undocumented inline chat settings. One minor correction should flag conflicting Microsoft guidance about whether Integrated Apps blocking also affects Teams.
